mapper.select: SELECT id, receiver_email, subject, content, status, retry_count, last_error, next_retry_time, create_time, update_time FROM notification_task WHERE status IN (0, 2, 3) AND (next_retry_time IS NULL OR next_retry_time <= #{now}) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_task SET status = 1, last_error = NULL, next_retry_time = NULL, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 3
UPDATE notification_task SET status = 2, retry_count = #{retryCount}, last_error = #{lastError}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 3
